40e44da202aacc298b31544851bc97f739c3e16a

pr_comments:
Merged rebased on `main` :+1: 

There is a possible future option/extra button for the warning dialog but there is no need to add it now, which is deleting the tilemaps but keeping the tilesets. But we'll see if it's required by the users later.

issue_context.title: Delete unused tilesets after deleting tilemaps
issue_context.body:
There is a bug where several tilesets are accumulate when tilemap layers are deleted. E.g. if we create 3 tilemaps:

![image](https://github.com/aseprite/aseprite/assets/39654/c8390598-1310-428b-b3ad-e4e072e3154c)

And then remove them, and try to create a new tilemap layer, we can see 3 tilesets that should have been removed:

![image](https://github.com/aseprite/aseprite/assets/39654/3fda6a98-2986-4ad3-ad58-8874a7894e36)

review_comments:
Probably I'd change the name to
```suggestion
LayerList SelectedLayers::onlyTilemaps() const
```
I used this name because there are toBrowsableLayerList and toAllLayersList methods already, so I tried to keep it consistent...let me know if I should rename it to onlyTilemaps anyway

Seeing that it returns a `LayerList` (and not a filtered/new `SelectedLayers`) it can be called `toAllTilemaps()` (I think all 3 names are confusing anyway, probably something to rename in the future).
